# Scalability & Extensibility

*Reflect on how easily the solution can grow and be maintained.*

*Suggestions:*

- *Is the agent built in a modular or parametrized way? How easily can it be
  extended or adapted?*
- *Can it scale to larger volumes or complex requirements? What would need to
  change?*
- *Which design choices support maintainability (e.g. sub-workflows, variables,
  reusable components, clear naming)?*

Discuss scalability, extensibility, and maintainability here.
